items.title: Bob Havens interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: We had an organist, Barbara Olsten, and well then we had two piano players. One was Larry Hooper and he was a bass singer that went back to the beginning of the television show.

ctx.x: In addition to the standard big band you had strings and a couple of other keyboard players.

We had an organist, Barbara Olsten, and well then we had two piano players. One was Larry Hooper and he was a bass singer that went back to the beginning of the television show. Then we got Bob Smale to play piano also, and Bob Ralston was the organist. So he had three keyboards and two guitars and of course Myron Floren was the accordion; well it was a very large band. It was a total of about 54 people on an airplane when we would travel.
And this was basically an every-day, like a full time job for you, right?
